pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with high-contrast, sharp pixel gradients at the edges. Geometry includes varied quadrilaterals and pentagons with large relative spatial area compared to the surrounding negative space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways forming tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness remains relatively uniform across the flank and neck, narrowing slightly towards the lower visible limbs.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, dark, elevated circular mass is visible on the anterior surface of the lower neck region.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian organism (oxpecker) perched on the dorsal ridge at the shoulder junction.
